lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Very Hot Day. The sun is shining. It is a very hot day.
lines.zh: 大热天。阳光灿烂，今天天气非常热。

lines.en: What a lovely hot day! Peppa and George are wearing their boots. They are going to jump in muddy puddles.
lines.zh: 多美好的大热天呀！佩奇和乔治穿着他们的靴子。他们要去泥坑里跳。

lines.en: I love muddy puddles! Oh! Oh, dear, the sun is so hot that the puddles have dried up.
lines.zh: 我喜欢泥坑！哦！哦，天哪，太阳太晒了，泥坑都干了。

lines.en: Mummy, Daddy, the puddles are all dry, and we can't jump in them! Never mind, Peppa, it's so sunny, you can play in the paddling pool instead! Yes, the paddling pool!
lines.zh: 妈妈，爸爸，泥坑都干了，我们不能跳了！没关系，佩奇，天气这么晴朗，你们可以改在戏水池里玩呀！好耶，戏水池！

lines.en: First, you have to change into your swimming costumes. Yes, Mummy!
lines.zh: 首先，你们得换上游泳衣。好的，妈妈！

lines.en: Peppa and George are wearing their swimming costumes. Mummy Pig is wearing her swimming costume, and Daddy Pig is wearing his swimming costume.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治穿上了游泳衣。猪妈妈穿着她的游泳衣，猪爸爸穿着他的游泳衣。

lines.en: Because it's so hot, you need sun cream.
lines.zh: 因为天气太热了，你们需要涂防晒霜。

lines.en: So oily and yucky! Yuck! What a fuss about nothing. Yes, we all need sun cream today.
lines.zh: 又油又黏，真讨厌！呸！真是小题大做。是的，今天我们全都需要涂防晒霜。

lines.en: Oh, come on, George, let's get some air into this paddling pool!
lines.zh: 哦，快点，乔治，我们给戏水池充点气吧！

lines.en: Daddy Pig is pumping up the paddling pool. Easy as pie!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸正在给戏水池打气。小菜一碟！

lines.en: Peppa holds the hose, and Mummy Pig turns on the water. Where's the water?
lines.zh: 佩奇拿着水管，猪妈妈打开水龙头。水在哪儿呢？

lines.en: Peppa and George love their paddling pool!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治喜欢他们的戏水池！

lines.en: Ice cream! Ice cream!
lines.zh: 冰淇淋！冰淇淋！

lines.en: Miss Rabbit, the ice cream lady. On very hot days, Miss Rabbit sells ice cream.
lines.zh: 是卖冰淇淋的兔子小姐。天气特别热的时候，兔子小姐就会来卖冰淇淋。

lines.en: Mummy, Daddy, can George and I have an ice cream, please? Oh, well, I suppose it is an especially hot day. Yes, please!
lines.zh: 妈妈，爸爸，我和乔治能吃冰淇淋吗？哦，好吧，今天确实特别热。好吧，买！

lines.en: Can I have one as well? Everyone likes ice cream! Hello, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George. Hello, Miss Rabbit. What ice creams would you like?
lines.zh: 我也能来一个吗？大家都喜欢冰淇淋！你们好，猪妈妈、佩奇和乔治。你好，兔子小姐。你们想要什么冰淇淋？

lines.en: Can I have a cone, please, Miss Rabbit? Of course you may, Peppa. Thank you! Thank you! The same for me, and one for Daddy Pig, please.
lines.zh: 兔子小姐，我可以要一个蛋筒冰淇淋吗？当然可以，佩奇。谢谢！谢谢！我也一样的，再给猪爸爸来一个。

lines.en: And what would young Mr. George like? Dinosaur! A dinosaur? Silly George, he always says dinosaur for everything. Well, it just so happens that I do have a dinosaur-shaped ice lolly!
lines.zh: 那小乔治先生想要什么呢？恐龙！恐龙？傻乔治，他不管什么都说恐龙。嗯，巧了，我还真有一根恐龙形状的冰棍！

lines.en: Dinosaur!
lines.zh: 恐龙！

lines.en: George, you should eat your ice lolly before it melts. Thank you! George loves his dinosaur ice lolly so much, he doesn't want to eat it.
lines.zh: 乔治，你该趁冰棍还没化把它吃了。谢谢！乔治太喜欢他的恐龙冰棍了，都舍不得吃。

lines.en: Thank you, Miss Rabbit! Enjoy the weather!
lines.zh: 谢谢你，兔子小姐！好好享受这天气吧！

lines.en: George, I really think you should eat your ice lolly before it melts and falls on the ground. Oh, dear, George's dinosaur ice lolly has melted and fallen on the ground!
lines.zh: 乔治，我真觉得你该趁它还没化掉、没掉在地上之前吃掉。哦，天哪，乔治的恐龙冰棍化掉掉在地上了！

lines.en: Never mind, George, you can share Daddy's ice cream. I'm sure he won't mind.
lines.zh: 没关系，乔治，你可以分爸爸的冰淇淋吃。我肯定他不会介意的。

lines.en: It is so warm. Daddy Pig has fallen asleep.
lines.zh: 天气太暖和了。猪爸爸睡着了。

lines.en: Daddy Pig does look hot. Let's pour water on Daddy to cool him down! Good idea!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸看起来确实很热。我们往爸爸身上泼点水，给他降降温吧！好主意！

lines.en: Peppa, what happened? You were all red and hot, Daddy Pig, so we put water on you! Oh, I see. Thank you.
lines.zh: 佩奇，发生什么事了？猪爸爸，你刚才又红又热，所以我们往你身上泼水啦！哦，我明白了。谢谢你们。

lines.en: Peppa, look, the puddles are back! Quick, George, let's get our boots!
lines.zh: 佩奇你看，泥坑又回来了！快点，乔治，我们去拿靴子！

lines.en: Peppa and George are wearing their boots. Peppa and George love the hot day, but most of all, they love jumping up and down in puddles!
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治穿上了他们的靴子。佩奇和乔治喜欢这个大热天，但最让他们开心的，还是在泥坑里跳上跳下！
